subject: E-1100: token rejected on Android
body:
Good morrning. My setup is SyncVault 4.2.5, Android 15 (Pixel 8). Whenever I log in since Tuesday,
the app shows "E-1100: authentication token rejected".

The failure is specific to the office network, the hotspot is fine. A new corporate proxy went live
for the wole staff this month.

I've already tried searching the help centre, which changed nothing.

Regards, Mei Lin, Ferro & Sons
